capabilities: insert a date sequence via end date or duration
format dates with configurable output patterns
wrap ranges in wiki links and create date files
wrap date sequences in a collapsible callout
extras: Author requests donations ('Say Thanks' section); dates in YYYYMMDD format, ranges limited to 1-100 units.
problem: Obsidian inserts single dates but has no built-in way to insert a full range of consecutive dates at once.
summary: Date insert helper that expands a start date with an end date or duration into a formatted, optionally wiki-linked date sequence.
